mapper.sql: config_id, config_name, user_type, commission_type, commission_value, min_commission, max_commission, effective_time, expiry_time, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_deleted, deleted_at, version, tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM global_commission_config WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND user_type = #{userType} AND (effective_time IS NULL OR effective_time <= NOW()) AND (expiry_time IS NULL OR expiry_time > NOW()) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT gcc.config_id, gcc.config_name, gcc.user_type, CASE gcc.user_type WHEN 1 THEN '采购员' WHEN 2 THEN '管理员' ELSE '未知' END AS user_type_name, gcc.commission_type, CASE gcc.commission_type WHEN 1 THEN '固定金额' WHEN 2 THEN '百分比' ELSE '未知' END AS commission_type_name, gcc.commission_value, gcc.min_commission, gcc.max_commission, gcc.effective_time, gcc.expiry_time, gcc.status, CASE gcc.status WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' WHEN 1 THEN '启用' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name, gcc.remark, gcc.created_by, gcc.created_at, gcc.updated_by, gcc.updated_at FROM global_commission_config gcc WHERE gcc.is_deleted = 0 AND gcc.config_id = #{configId}
